integrity: The finite algebraic positivity certificate uses exact rational arithmetic; the proof separately establishes cubic parameter dependence, extending all checked residue families to infinitely many pairs. Independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Only coprime integers m>n with 7<=m-n<=17; no assertion about gaps >=18, irrational exponents, exact locations or simplicity of zeros. Possible unindexed equivalent results require independent comparison.
title: Bergman zeros for every rational Hartogs numerator gap from seven through seventeen
